description: This file contains implementation details for managing loose Git objects, including functions for initializing, loading, writing, and manipulating loose object maps, as well as handling related file I/O and memory management.

methods.name: int should_use_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Checks if the repository configuration indicates the use of loose object maps based on hash algorithm and git directory presence.

methods.name: int insert_oid_pair(kh_oid_map_t * map,const struct object_id * key,const struct object_id * value)
methods.description: Inserts a pair of object IDs into a map, allocating memory for the stored object.

methods.name: int insert_loose_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Inserts object ID pairs into the loose object map and updates the object tree cache.

methods.name: int load_one_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo,struct odb_source * source)
methods.description: Loads loose object mappings from a file into the repository's loose object map structure, initializing cache as needed.

methods.name: int repo_read_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Reads and loads loose object maps for all sources in the repository if applicable.

methods.name: int repo_write_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Serializes and writes the loose object map to disk.

methods.name: int write_one_object(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Appends a single object ID pair to the loose object index file, creating the file if necessary.

methods.name: int repo_add_loose_object_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Adds a new loose object mapping and writes it to disk if it is inserted.

methods.name: int repo_loose_object_map_oid(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Retrieves a mapped object ID from the loose object map based on source and target hash algorithm.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_clear(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the loose object map, including object ID entries and map structures.
